segments.en: On day 10, Alex has a small task. Alex has practised the basics, so the team gives Alex a small task. First, Alex checks "terminal" and "command line" and writes one clear note about the work. During a short chat, Maria uses "make an appointment" and "reschedule the meeting". Alex answers politely and asks one question. Then Alex records the progress with "status check" and "required check" so the team can follow the change. The task is not big, but Alex can now explain it from start to finish.
